contexts.text: (They said) he could not agree with them, who were little.
The little Spirits (of the moon). AC 9232:end.
From little even to great () = in particular and in general. AC 8718.
(The city) is little () = that it was allowable from the little (of truth) which he had. Explained. AC 2431.
(The Spirits of Saturn) esteem themselves as relatively little; and therefore in the other life they appear little.
A space of invisible littleness.
(The notion that Heaven is little.)
Thou hast a little power () = they know that they can avail nothing from themselves.
Small and great () = those who in a less and greater degree fear the Lord. (Compare AR 604. AR 810. AR 866.)
The Spiritual is like itself in a little volume as in a great one.
These two loves (of dominion and possessing) can reign more with the small than the great...
See Great. AE 696. AE 836. AE 1212.
a. [end]. They supposed themselves great, although so small.
A certain little one thrust them down.
Those on high seem to themselves, and also appear to me, small; for the one phantasy produces the other.
a. Small naked riders seen.
He emerged a snowy little something.
The profane were then seen small...
That they should rest yet for a little time () = still some duration in that state.
His innocence... is signified by little Benjamin (). ( = the innocence of the natural man. AE 449:9.)
In the Spiritual World, when those who are in a persuasion of their own eminence look at others, they see them as little and vile, and the latter also seem such to themselves. Signified.
To give one of the little ones to drink... () = to teach innocence from innocence... Little ones = the innocent; and, abstractedly, innocence.
